source: Mutopia Project, division-violin-01 (Public Domain), from Playford's Division Violin (1685); converted with tools/midi2pipit.py. 12 notes outside the soprano's range are moved by an octave. The opening tuning chord is left out.

about.en: John Playford's "The Division Violin" (1685) collected divisions, sets of ever busier variations, played over a repeating bass, the ground. Violinists, viol and recorder players all played from it. This set by Reddings opens the book.
about.nl: John Playfords "The Division Violin" (1685) verzamelde diminuties, reeksen van steeds drukkere variaties, gespeeld boven een herhaalde bas, de grond. Violisten, gambisten en blokfluitisten speelden er allemaal uit. Deze reeks van Reddings opent het boek.

tip.en: Each division is four bars over the same ground, played twice. Practise one at a time, slowly at first.
tip.nl: Elke diminutie is vier maten boven dezelfde grond, twee keer gespeeld. Oefen er één tegelijk, eerst traag.
